verdict.rationale: Open and click tracking is clearly documented (mailgun-docs-27), and Mailgun pushes real-time event data to applications via webhooks (mailgun-docs-8). Community users praise its logging and debugging dashboards (mailgun-comm-15, mailgun-comm-10), and the SDKs claim tracking support (mailgun-docs-32). However, no evidence explicitly documents an API endpoint for querying a per-message event history; it is only implied by the webhooks page's 'without API polling' wording and by the community's praise of logging. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an Events/logs query API with per-message filtering, details on event retention and payloads, hands-on corroboration of answering 'what happened to this email?' via the API.
